{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print(sales.head())
print(sales['customer_segment'].unique())
print(sales['status'].unique())
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check if 'loyal' segment exists
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in sales['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"'loyal' segment exists: {loyal_exists}")

# Check if revenue is numeric
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")"}
